create.name: Buddha House
create.bio:
Buddha House, Centre for Advanced Buddhist Studies, is a Tibetan Buddhist centre of the FPMT network in Magill, a suburb in Adelaide's east, set in a restored church more than a century old. It began in 1981 after Lama Thubten Yeshe gave three evenings of teachings in Adelaide; when local students asked for a place to keep learning, he agreed that a centre should start and chose its name himself. Its resident teacher, Venerable Thubten Dondrub, was born in Adelaide, has been a monk for decades and is known in FPMT circles for leading lam-rim retreats, including the November course at Kopan Monastery.

The weekly timetable mixes meditation and study: a beginners' class on breath awareness, Sunday lam-rim meditations led by experienced students, a Buddhist mind-science course, and multi-week study of texts such as Shantideva's Guide to the Bodhisattva's Way of Life, alongside day courses with Gen Dondrub and visits from FPMT geshes. Meditation sessions cost a small donation in the gompa and are free when streamed online. Membership brings reduced fees, library borrowing and shop discounts.

courses.title: A Buddhist Approach to Death & Dying with Gen Dondrub
courses.description: A one-day course of talks and guided meditations with the resident teacher on how Buddhism understands dying, impermanence and the continuity of mind, and how to prepare calmly for one's own death and support others. Meals and teas are included for those attending in person.
courses.price: In person: Waged $85, Members & Concession $70; Online: $50

courses.title: Lam Rim Meditation
courses.description: A Sunday morning hour in which experienced students guide a meditation on a different stage of the path each week. Some familiarity with Mahayana ideas helps but is not required.

courses.title: Learn to Meditate
courses.description: A Monday evening class for all levels that starts from simple attention to the breath, held in the gompa and also streamed.
courses.price: Small donation in person; free online

courses.title: Become a Member
courses.description: Yearly membership, paid annually or monthly, with library borrowing, reduced fees for teachings and retreats, a shop discount and voting rights. Higher Bodhisattva levels include free entry to courses.
courses.price: Lotus: Waged $180 per year, Concession $120 per year (higher levels listed on page)
